mechanics.claim: While channeling Meditate, Master Yi cannot attack; a basic attack interrupts the channel.
Meditate resets Master Yi's basic attack timer on cast.
mechanics.quote: ''Meditate {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Master Yi's''' basic attack timer

mechanics.claim: While channeling, Meditate pauses the duration of Wuju Style and Highlander, so those buffs are preserved but not advanced while the channel is active.
mechanics.quote: pauses ''{{ais|Wuju Style|Master Yi}}'' and ''{{ais|Highlander|Master Yi}}'' duration

mechanics.claim: Meditate channels for up to 4 seconds, during which Master Yi deals no damage (no auto-attacks or other abilities cast).
Meditate's healing and damage reduction have no effect on a stationary dummy that never attacks back.
